title: Single-cell chromatin profiling reveals relapse-related priming in pediatric acute myeloid leukemia.
snippet: Relapse remains the leading cause of treatment failure and mortality in pediatric acute myeloid leukemia (pAML), yet the early molecular features underlying relapse susceptibility remain poorly understood.
